description: Audit-Driven Development registry. Rules are the living spec.

rules.description: 実行前後に git status を確認する
ArchiMate language profile and migration tests pass
C260 book-derived section, aggregate, outline, and source-runlog coverage audit passes
Appendix C example viewpoint headings remain exposed as an informative catalog without bundling normative viewpoint definitions
rules.command: node --test --test-name-pattern "Appendix C example viewpoints as an informative catalog" test/language-profile.test.mjs

rules.description: Appendix C informative viewpoint catalog is exposed through implementation status and the completion scan

ArchiMate model validation diagnostics cover profile mismatch, retired concepts, relationship rules, multiplicity, junction consistency, view viewpoint references, view node element references, view connection relationship references, model-defined and profile-defined viewpoint allowed-type application to View contents, viewpoint stakeholder/concern structure, viewpoint definitions, and profile attribute property values
ESLint passes for ArchiMate 4 implementation files
